summary: Evaluate a neural decoder across changing sessions and then study its behavior in a simulated interactive task.
outcomes: Compare chronological offline evaluation with closed-loop simulation.
Document adaptation, latency, faults and operational limitations.
sequence: Select a supported open benchmark or synthetic dataset
Define future-session splits and causal features
Train a simple baseline and one alternative
Connect to an isolated cursor simulator
Inject faults and deliver an operational report

visual.question: Does better held-out prediction improve the simulated user's task?
visual.interaction: Swap decoders and vary delay, drift and dropout while preserving the task definition.

practice.task: Deliver a rerunnable decoder comparison and software-only failure demonstration.
practice.success: Includes fair adaptation access, baseline results, fault recovery and limits of simulated-user evidence.
